description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for VBScript in the CodeMirror code editor, including tokenization rules, keywords, functions, and configuration for ASP support.

methods.name: wordRegexp
methods.description: Creates a regular expression to match a list of words case-insensitively.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Main tokenizer function that classifies parts of the code into syntax categories.

methods.name: tokenStringFactory
methods.description: Creates a tokenizer for string literals.

methods.name: tokenLexer
methods.description: Handles token styles, especially for identifiers connected with dots.
